review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for related declarations. The only candidates are `uliftMultiplesHom` and `uliftPowersHom`, which are universe-lifted variants of `multiplesHom` and `powersHom` in Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Nat/Hom.lean. Each is built by composing the existing equivalence with `AddEquiv.ulift` or `MulEquiv.ulift`. The module docstring says they are deliberate universe-monomorphic variants. They have different types, because `M : Type u` and the domain is `ULift.{u} ℕ`. They are needed so the corepresenting object lives in `Type u`. Mathlib/Algebra/Category/Grp/ForgetCorepresentable.lean has parallel declarations (`uliftZMultiplesHom` and `uliftZPowersHom`), so the pattern is consistent across the library. Nothing else in Mathlib duplicates them, and the `coyonedaObjIsoForget` isomorphisms and `IsCorepresentable` instances are per-category named API with no competing existing version. I found no justified duplication finding, so I abstain.
